summary: The `datetime()` and `datetime_utc()` functions panic on an invalid format string from the justfile, because chrono's formatter errors and to_string() panics on that.
`mod foo '/outside/dir'` pointing at a directory with both `justfile` and `.justfile` panics while building the ambiguity error, because strip_prefix(parent) fails for a path outside the parent.
A whitespace-only argument to `--show` or `--usage` becomes an empty module path, and resolve_path computes components.len() - 1 on it and panics.
`just --dry-run` still runs the commands in shell() function calls, so a dry run has side effects, while backticks are correctly skipped.
`set fallback` discards every error from searching parent directories, so an ambiguous parent justfile is reported as an unknown recipe.
Command-line overrides (`just x=1`) are ignored inside user-defined functions, whose evaluator gets an empty overrides map and so re-evaluates the original assignment.
Variable lookup checks the scope before assignments, so a variable that shadows a builtin constant (`a := HEX` with `HEX := 'foo'`) yields the constant when referenced from another assignment.
An invalid `--timestamp-format` panics when a recipe line prints its timestamp, through the same chrono to_string() pattern as the datetime functions but at a separate call site.

A module cycle written through `..` (`mod bar '../justfile'`) is not detected, because the module path is not normalized before the cycle check, so just reloads the files until the path exceeds the OS limit.
